roster_grade.headline: 13-3, most points, #1 in title odds. McCaffrey is in; now turn bench QB Shough into Jeremiyah Love and get younger at RB
roster_grade.window_explanation: #1 composite title odds in Week 8: #1 by record (13-3), #1 in points for (1,157), #4 by roster value. That's a win-now team. Keep every producing starter (Mahomes, McCaffrey, Henry, Javonte, Hubbard unless swapped for a better RB, Nix, the starting WRs, Loveland) and spend true surplus (Shough, Daniels, DeVonta Smith, Gunnar Helm, bench WRs, picks) on the one soft spot: an aging RB room (need 0.4, aging 1.0).

strengths.label: Best record and most points
strengths.detail: 13-3 with 1,157 points for. One game clear of Buck-ee's and Phil's (12-4), and 53 points ahead of dickcole2410 (1,104) for the PF lead.

strengths.label: McCaffrey added to the lineup
strengths.detail: Christian McCaffrey (4,604) is now starting at RB. San Francisco is scoring 3.7 a game over Vegas, so his numbers are strong. Hold him for the title run.

strengths.label: Spare QBs on the bench
strengths.detail: Mahomes and Nix start, with Shough (3,865) and Jalon Daniels (670) on the bench. Superflex only starts two, so both are tradeable. QB need is 0.02.

strengths.label: Deep WR and TE groups
strengths.detail: Parker Washington, Higgins, and Watson start; DeVonta Smith (2,792) and Malik Washington sit, Stribling is on IR. WR need is 0.0. Loveland starts at TE with Hockenson and Gunnar Helm behind him (TE need 0.0).

weaknesses.label: Aging RB room
weaknesses.detail: McCaffrey (30), Henry (32), Javonte (26), Hubbard (27), and Kamara (31) are all Declining. RB need is 0.4 with an aging score of 1.0, the only real need on the roster.

weaknesses.label: RB depth is thin
weaknesses.detail: RJ Harvey is on IR, so one more RB injury puts Kamara or a taxi rookie in the lineup.

weaknesses.label: Two starting RBs running hot
weaknesses.detail: McCaffrey and Hubbard are on offenses scoring 3.7 a game over Vegas. Expect some cooling. Hold McCaffrey; Hubbard is the one to swap for a younger starter.

roster_grade.most_urgent_action: Sell Tyler Shough off your bench: Shough + Malik Washington for Jeremiyah Love (Undefeated In My Dreams, 1-15, Long shot, Dart on IR). That's 5,057 for 5,144. Add DeVonta Smith for Omarion Hampton in the same deal if they'll bite (7,849 for 8,145). Keep Mahomes, McCaffrey, Henry, Javonte, Nix, Loveland, and the starting WRs.

QB.commentary: Mahomes and Nix start, with Shough and Daniels on the bench. Four QBs for two slots. Shough is the chip, Daniels is a package piece. Nix's Denver offense is 1.7 a game under Vegas, so there's room to bounce.

RB.commentary: McCaffrey, Javonte, Henry, and Hubbard all start, which is better than last week, but every one of them is Declining and Harvey is on IR. This is the position to upgrade (need 0.4).

WR.commentary: Parker Washington, Higgins, and Watson start, DeVonta Smith and Malik Washington sit, and Stribling is on IR. Watson's Green Bay offense is 3.1 a game under Vegas, so expect a bounce. Smith is the WR to move.

TE.commentary: Loveland is the long-term TE1, with Hockenson and Gunnar Helm behind him. Need is 0.0, so Helm is a package piece.

trade_priority_order: Shough + Malik Washington → Jeremiyah Love (Undefeated In My Dreams, 1-15, Long shot, Dart on IR). 5,057 for 5,144.
DeVonta Smith → Omarion Hampton (same team; Chargers are 6.6 a game under Vegas, the biggest buy-low on the board). 2,792 for 3,001. Bundle with the Love deal if possible.
Hubbard + Gunnar Helm + Zavion Thomas → Kyren Williams (You Hate Us, Long shot and selling, weak at RB and TE). 4,031 for 4,067. Sells Hubbard at his hot-offense peak.
Jalon Daniels + 2027 2nd + Josh Cameron + Tory Horton → Breece Hall (Bijan Mustard, 4-12, weak at QB). 3,282 for 3,410.
Sell Kamara to Rolling Ball (10-6, weak at RB, buying) for a 2027 3rd, once one of the RBs above lands.
All-in alternative to the Love deal: Shough + Javonte Williams + 2027 2nd + 2028 3rd → Bijan Robinson (Bijan Mustard).
Hold Mahomes, McCaffrey, Henry, Nix, Loveland, and the starting WRs. You're 13-3.

A starter, but 27, Declining, and inflated by Carolina scoring 3.7 a game over Vegas. Swapping him for a better starting RB is an upgrade, not a sell.

do_not_trade: Christian McCaffrey (starting RB on a 13-3 team)
Parker Washington / Tee Higgins / Christian Watson (starting WRs)
trade_strategy.pick_strategy: You're 13-3, so picks are currency. Use the two 2027 2nds and the 3rds/4ths to close gaps on RB deals. Hold the extra 2028 1st unless it lands Bijan or Love outright.

outlook.projected_power_rank: #1 composite title odds (#1 record, #1 PF, #4 value). You're the top seed if the lineup holds.
outlook.three_year_outlook: Win now with the Mahomes/McCaffrey/Loveland/WR core. Adding a young RB this season (Love, Hampton, Hall, or Bijan) also covers 2027, when McCaffrey, Henry, and Kamara age out.
outlook.season_narrative: The Jabroni Beaters are 13-3 in Week 8: best record, most points (1,157), and #1 in title odds, with McCaffrey now in the RB room. Shough is a bench QB holding real value, and five Long shot teams hold the RBs you want. Shough, DeVonta Smith, Daniels, and Hubbard can buy a younger RB room without weakening the lineup.
key_risks: Regression: McCaffrey and Hubbard are on offenses scoring 3.7 a game over Vegas
An RB injury, with Harvey already on IR
Rolling Ball (10-6, weak at RB, buying) is competing with you for the same sellers' RBs
key_upside_factors: Landing Love, Hampton, Kyren, Hall, or Bijan turns RB into a strength
Watson (-3.1) and Nix (-1.7) are on offenses under their Vegas totals, so expect a bounce
Stribling and Harvey coming back from IR add depth for the playoff run
